scenes.say: Goosebumps are left over from when our ancestors had fur.
Every hair on your body has a tiny muscle attached.
scenes.heading: ZOOM IN

scenes.say: When you're cold or scared, those muscles pull the hairs up. And the skin around them bumps up too.
scenes.heading: COLD OR SCARED

scenes.say: For furry animals, that's useful. Fluffed-up fur traps heat. And makes you look bigger to enemies.
scenes.heading: FOR FURRY ANIMALS

scenes.say: Think of a cat puffing up when it's scared.
Even porcupine quills are special hairs, raised by the same kind of muscle.
scenes.heading: EVEN PORCUPINES

scenes.say: We lost most of our fur. But the reflex stayed. Which is why a great song can still give you chills.
scenes.heading: THE TWIST
